data.command: What security tools do you have deployed?

data.text:
webapp@web-prod-03:~$ dpkg -l | grep -iE 'snort|suricata|clam|ossec|fail2ban|aide|rkhunter|audit|wazuh|falco|tripwire' | awk '{print $2, $3}'
